digital_purchases_content.question: Does the game include the purchase or sale of digital goods, cash rewards, gift cards, play-to-earn features, convertible cryptocurrency rewards, or the issuance of transferable digital assets (e.g., NFTs)?

digital_purchases_includes.question: If Yes, select all that the game includes

options.value: Cash Convertible Rewards - Cash rewards, real-world items of significant monetary value, convertible cryptocurrency rewards or other play-to-earn mechanics
Issuance (e.g., minting) of transferable digital assets (e.g., NFTs)

loot_box_purchases.question: Can these purchases include random items where the purchaser doesn't know what specific items or features they will receive (e.g., loot boxes), the purchase of items that will be used to create or unlock an unknown item or feature (e.g., a key to unlock a loot box, material used to craft a random item), items that can improve the rate of earning random items (e.g., random drop boosts), or any other chance-based purchases?

user_trade_system.question: Does the game have a system for players to trade items with each other using real money or in-game currency purchased with real money? (e.g. auction house, item exchange)

wager_purchases.question: Does the game include the ability or requirement to wager, purchase entrance fees, additional chances to win, boosts, or any other purchases potentially related to earning or winning cash rewards or rewards of significant monetary value?

show_if.answer: Cash Convertible Rewards - Cash rewards, real-world items of significant monetary value, convertible cryptocurrency rewards or other play-to-earn mechanics

digital_assets_promoted.question: Is the issuance of these digital assets a significant or promoted aspect of the product?

show_if.answer: Issuance (e.g., minting) of transferable digital assets (e.g., NFTs)

integrated_marketplace.question: Does the game contain an integrated marketplace for these assets or promote/feature a particular marketplace for these assets?

show_if.answer: Issuance (e.g., minting) of transferable digital assets (e.g., NFTs)

assets_purchase_requirement.question: Does the game include the ability or requirement to make any purchases related to the issuance or earning of these digital assets?

show_if.answer: Issuance (e.g., minting) of transferable digital assets (e.g., NFTs)
